summary: The patched package (solution/fix.patch applied by solve.sh) implements every SOP TM-07 rule (fitted-intercept OLS, readings, blank mean of results, corrected-reading amount and flags, rounded inclusive CCV pass, two-sided bracketing, spike recovery on results) and keeps the shipped calculation, fed with SOP-defined values, exactly where the SOP gives no rule; no contract-violating behavior found.
checks_performed: Reconciled all 21 manifest files with files read; none truncated.

Verified each fix.patch hunk's context lines against the shipped source line numbers (blanks.py 1-8, calib.py 9-17, qc.py 6-21, report.py 15-18/30-32/38-43/60-65, samples.py 6-18); Dockerfile installs patch and solve.sh applies with -p1 from /.
Traced SOP 2: patched calib.fit_line computes mean-centred OLS slope and intercept = mean_y - slope*mean_x; sxx > 0 guaranteed by SOP 1 (two distinct concentrations).

Traced SOP 3/4: blank results filtered by reading >= mdl (blanks judged on reading), mean of all such blanks anywhere in run order; with no result falls back to shipped first-blank reading else 0.0, computed from SOP readings.
Traced SOP 5: amount = (reading - level) * dilution; flag uses corrected reading: < mdl ND (value null), < loq J, else empty; mdl == loq gives empty flag at/above mdl.
Traced SOP 6: recovery = reading/true*100 reported unrounded; pass = 90.0 <= round(recovery,1) <= 110.0; SOP 1 excludes rounding ties so Python round is safe.

Traced SOP 6 bracketing: with CCVs on both sides uses before[-1] and after[0] and requires both passed; otherwise shipped rule (nearest before, else True) with SOP pass values. Checked that rebinding `before` in the fallback loop is harmless because the both-sides branch returns first.

Traced SOP 7: detected = corrected >= mdl for spike and parent; both results -> (spike amount - parent amount)/added*100; else shipped formula divided by added*dilution using SOP amounts; added >= 0.001 so recovery is always a number.
Traced SOP 8: blank_levels keyed by name; samples/ccvs/spikes in run order then analyte order; None serialises to null; driver unchanged.
Ordinary-case trace on examples/small-batch.json structure (CCV, blank, sample, spike, sample, CCV) through bracketing, blank level and spike recovery branches.

fix.patch touches only files under app/src/metalquant; solve.sh does not modify tools/.

Mean-centred OLS and direct arithmetic are well within 1e-6 relative tolerance for slopes 1e-12..1e6, readings to 1e4 and amounts to 1e7; no division by zero reachable (sxx>0, true>0, added>=0.001, is_counts>=1000).

interaction_sweep.case_or_path: Blanks with readings below and above mdl in any run position: only readings >= mdl averaged; all-ND blanks fall back to first blank reading.
Blank level subtracted before dilution multiplies; flag judged on corrected reading not amount (e.g. corrected 0.5 at dilution 10 with mdl 1 -> ND).
Spike or parent corrected reading below mdl -> shipped added*dilution denominator with SOP amounts; both results -> SOP 7 formula.
Sample between a CCV with recovery rounding to 110.0 (pass) and one rounding to 110.1 (fail) -> ccv_ok false; sample after last CCV uses nearest-before pass; batch with no CCV -> true.
mdl == loq: corrected >= mdl yields empty flag (no J), corrected < mdl yields ND.
